skill.summary: Turn a 10-minute YouTube tutorial video into 1080p captioned video files just by typing what you need. Whether it's adding auto-generated subtitles to videos...

latestVersion.changelog:
Subtitle Generator Extension Chrome 1.0.0

- Initial release of the Chrome extension for AI-powered subtitle generation and video export.
- Upload video files or paste video URLs for automatic subtitle creation and embedding.
- Supports quick workflows: generate subtitles, edit, preview, and export videos in 1080p MP4 and more formats.
- Processes videos entirely in the cloud—no installation required, results in 30–60 seconds for short clips.
- Anonymous users receive free trial credits and session management is fully automatic.
- Extensive API error handling, session recovery, and common edit/export workflows described for easy use.
